findings.body:
**Require bot threads to be resolved before merge.**

This sentence permits merging with unresolved bot threads. The repository review instruction requires every thread and finding to be fixed or answered with a reason, and every thread to be resolved. Based on learnings, this requirement includes bot and minor findings.
findings.title: Require bot threads to be resolved before merge.

findings.body:
**Name the pre-merge CRQ review path in the README.**

Line 5 says CRQ reviews "after merge." A reader can take that as the only CRQ timing. The merge policy and AGENTS.md accept a crq review before merge when its reviewed range ends at the head and its findings are addressed. The README's Review section also lists only the agent PASS and human PASS, so a merging agent reading only the README can reject a valid pre-merge CRQ review. Add the pre-merge condition to the sentence.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-after merge. See [merge policy](../docs/promotion-policy.md).
+after merge. A CRQ review also counts before merge when its reviewed range ends at the head and its findings are addressed. See [merge policy](../docs/promotion-policy.md).
```

</details>
findings.title: Name the pre-merge CRQ review path in the README.

findings.body:
**Carve out `cq-review[bot]` agent PASS reviews from the bot-author exclusion.**

The sentence at lines 33-34 excludes every bot author from the review signal. The canonical doctrine and the templates README both state that an exact-head `cq-review[bot]` agent PASS counts as independent review without a `crq-findings` marker. Readers who follow this README can reject valid review evidence and delay merges. Add the carve-out to the sentence, and keep the exclusion for other bot authors.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-authors (Bot type or `[bot]` suffix) do not count as that signal. No HTML
+authors (Bot type or `[bot]` suffix) do not count as that signal, except an
+exact-head `cq-review[bot]` agent PASS, which counts without a `crq-findings`
+marker. No HTML
```

</details>
findings.title: Carve out `cq-review[bot]` agent PASS reviews from the bot-author exclusion.
